text:
FIFA Wiase Kupu a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no kɔɔ so wɔ France fi 4 kɔsi 19 June 1938, ɛyɛ ɛberɛ a edi kan na ɛyɛ ne nko ara a wɔde too hɔ wɔ hɔ ansa na 1998 reba, na ɛyɛ nea edi akyire a wɔde too hɔ ansa na ɔko no agyae mfe du-mmienu nti. Wɔbɔɔ no wɔ ɔko a ɛrefi so wɔ Europe, na wɔde kɔɔ so kɔɔ teams 15: teams 16 na wɔatwa wɔn din, nanso Austria gyaee wɔ German annexation, Anschluss akyi, na ɛmaa Sweden nya walkover wɔ round a edi kan no mu. Nhyehyeɛ no yɛ single-elimination knockout fii round of 16, na wɔde extra time na replay si akan a ɛyɛ draw, na wɔde third-place play-off ma semi-finalists a wɔadi nkogu.

Italy, a Vittorio Pozzo na ɔhwɛ wɔn so, bae sɛ atitiriw a wɔrebɔ ho ban na wɔfaa bracket no mu kɔɔ final a wɔbɔɔ wɔ Stade Olympique de Colombes wɔ Colombes, Paris kɛseɛ mu, wɔ nnipa bɛyɛ 45,000 anim. Ɛhɔ na wɔne Hungary hyiae. Gino Colaussi ne Silvio Piola bɔɔ mmienu mmienu maa Azzurri, na Pal Titkos ne Gyorgy Sarosi nso bɔɔ Hungary, na Italy dii 4-2 nkonim bere a extra time nni ho. Ɛno nti wɔbɛyɛ ɔman a edi kan a wadi Wiase Kupu no ho ban pɛpɛɛpɛ, ɛyɛ ɔbarima kuo nko ara a wadi nkonim mmienu a ɛtoatoa mu kɔsi sɛ Brazil dii saa adeɛ no wɔ 1962.

Brazil dii mmiɛnsa, na wɔde Sweden dii 4-2 wɔ play-off a wɔbɔɔ wɔ Bordeaux. Ɔbarima a ɔda nso wɔ tournament no mu ne Brazil Leonidas, ɔsram a ɛhyerɛn sen biara na ɔyɛ top scorer a ɔbɔɔ goals 7; anansesɛm a wɔka daa sɛ ɔbɔɔ akan biako mu bere bi a nan nni ne nan so no da so wɔ akasakasa mu. FIFA amma best-player award biara, ɛfiri sɛ wɔantɔ Golden Ball ho kwan kɔsi 1982.

Ɛfiri sɛ wɔtwaa 1942 ne 1946 nkonimdie no mu nti ɔko a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Second World War nti, ɛyɛ Wiase Kupu a edi akyire ansa na mfe du-mmienu agyae, na Italy kuraa abodin no mfe 16, kɔsi 1950.
